_comment: 3D 'hero' buildings made of real Downtown City MegaKit pieces (CC0, assets/city/kit-pieces.glb) on the normal building footprints, in a few zones (start area, some landmarks). Other buildings keep the baked-texture boxes. Shown on the quality levels where data/quality.json → heroBuildings is true. zones: at = 'spawn' (Shoumik's start crossing) or a place id from data/places.json; radius in metres; maxTriangles = budget for the zone (nearest buildings first); buildings with fewer floors than minFloors or more than maxFloors are skipped (towers keep the textured look). A zone's 3D meshes are built when Shoumik comes within buildDistance and thrown away beyond dropDistance. styles: one per building style (blockgen.js): upper = window pieces (picked per building), side = blank side walls, ground / shop = ground floor, door = pieces making the front door [name, x offset], cornice = row along the top of street sides, every = 2 puts a plain 'between' piece after each window. glassColor = window glass (it also reflects the sky). pieces = every kit piece that gets packed (tools/city-kit/pack-pieces.js).
